scenes.text: Did you know you are actually aging faster than the center of the Earth?
Thanks to Albert Einstein’s theory of relativity, we know that gravity literally warps time, making it run slower where gravity is strongest.
Because of this intense gravitational time dilation deep underground, the Earth’s core is actually two and a half years younger than its outer crust.
Every second you spend on the surface, you are traveling into the future just slightly faster than the rocks beneath your feet, so hit follow for more mind-blowing science!

meta.title: The center of the Earth is actually younger than the crust #shorts
meta.description:
Did you know you are actually aging faster than the center of the Earth? It sounds like science fiction, but the core of our planet is physically younger than its surface. Thanks to Albert Einstein’s theory of relativity, we know that gravity literally warps time. The stronger the gravity, the slower time moves. Because the Earth's core is surrounded by massive weight, gravity pulls much harder down there. Scientists calculated that because of this intense gravitational time dilation, the Earth’s core is actually two and a half years younger than its crust. Think about that. Every single second you spend standing up here, you are traveling into the future just a tiny bit faster than the rocks beneath your feet. Would you travel to a place where time moves slower if you could? Hit follow for more mind-blowing space secrets.
